title: kb!: reads a negated word as the issue, so 'nothing wrong with PATH:LINE' records outcome misled and flags a correct line
goal: read_user_report leaves a word under a negation (not, nothing, no) out of the closed fields, so a positive kb!: report records no misled outcome and no wrong or stale line; the text stays a redacted comment. Found by the SP-ficl7pxl review (ST-h3y6iym4 gate g2).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_capture as C;r=[C.read_user_report(t,lambda x:x) for t in ["nothing wrong with public/claude/hooks.md:60, it is right","not stale: public/claude/hooks.md:60 is current"]];print(r);sys.exit(1 if any((x or {}).get("outcome")=="misled" or any(l.get("issue") in ("wrong","stale") for l in ((x or {}).get("lines") or [])) for x in r) else 0)
